environment.description: ECS Fargate task running on platform version 1.4.0 with awsvpc networking mode. Container runs behind an internal ALB with no WAF attached. Task IAM role has s3:GetObject and secretsmanager:GetSecretValue permissions. The Flask application is served directly via Gunicorn with default Werkzeug header handling. No input validation middleware. Container image based on python:3.9-slim with requests library.
